changes.title: Readable on any phone, with tap to call.
changes.text: Today the site opens as a shrunken desktop page and the office, cell and shop numbers are plain text. The concept puts a call button at the top of every screen.

changes.title: A panel quote request.
changes.text: There is no form on the current site, only email links. The concept adds a short request for panel type, application and due date.

changes.title: Emergency service up front.
changes.text: Your weekend emergency service and UL 508A and 698A listings sit on inner pages today. The concept leads with them.
